snippet.title: AZUR - Official Announcement Trailer | PvP Survival FPS
snippet.description:
AZUR is a PvP survival FPS set on a dangerous Mediterranean island.

Fight other players, deal with the Riptides, loot what you can and try to make it out alive. If you die, you can lose everything.

Wishlist AZUR on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3979490/AZUR/

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/T8PzeCgn2x

Official website:
https://www.azurthegame.com/

Coming to PC in 2027

#AZUR #SurvivalFPS #SurvivalGame
